name: computer
description: Vyre Computer: one front door over the cloud computer, your Macs and the screen engines. Computers are chosen by name; interface first, screen last.

tips.text: Tell an agent where to work: "on my Mac" or "on the office computer". Left out, it works on its own cloud computer.
A box agent works on your Mac only for what you allow there: look, act or files. Each is off until you turn it on.
Type # and pick a login to let an agent sign in with it in this conversation. It types the login for itself and never sees it.

settings.label: Vyre Computer as my default browser
settings.help: On tells every assistant and agent to use Vyre Computer (the cloud computer, or the Mac you name) first for anything that needs a browser, whichever AI runs it. The AI's own browsing tool stays available when Vyre Computer cannot do the job.
